import { customizeTable } from "@rebasepro/cms";
import type { products } from "../../../backend/schema/products";

export const productsCms = customizeTable<typeof products>("products", {
    icon: "Package",
    display: {
        title: "productName"
    },
    listFields: [
        "productId",
        "productName",
        "category",
        "quantityPerUnit",
        "unitPrice",
        "unitsInStock"
    ],
    fieldOrder: [
        "productId",
        "productName",
        "category",
        "quantityPerUnit",
        "unitPrice",
        "unitsInStock",
        "unitsOnOrder",
        "reorderLevel",
        "discontinued",
        "supplier"
    ]
});
